If you’re an avid reader, don’t miss these four top bookstores in the Highland Park, MI, area. If you like your books pre-owned, Detroit Specials is your spot for a wide selection across fiction and nonfiction genres. It’s been operating since 2015 and donates a portion of sales to animal rescue organizations throughout the city.
